decisions.evidence: Across all six neighbors, the dominant theme is that the query repeatedly carries the nitroso feature, and that structural alert consistently supports the mutagenic label. Some negative neighbors introduce countervailing signals from size, ring count, polarity, ketone content, fluorene, and other surface-area descriptors, but those do not outweigh the repeated nitroso-based evidence. With three positive neighbors and three negative neighbors all showing the same core alert pattern rather than a clean counterexample, the combined local analog evidence supports option (B): is mutagenic.
